title: Constitutional Capitalism Narration Style Guide
freeze_gate: Default pace/energy feel right on 3 signature paragraphs when read aloud
Pause grammar for section openings/closings locked
Pronunciation dictionary covers chapter proper nouns
Regeneration rule: fix paragraph, never whole chapter

voice.desired_character: Measured adult narrator; thoughtful not theatrical; Arkansas-adjacent American English without caricature; authority without lecturing

chapter_open.performance_note: Chapter opening. Do not rush into the argument.

chapter_close.performance_note: Chapter landing. Leave space after the final line.

emotional_range.note: Restrained firmness beats volume. Hope is earned, not performed.

punctuation_and_emphasis.short_sentence: may carry more weight; do not race
punctuation_and_emphasis.emphasis_words: lean, do not punch unless signature passage

numbers.years: say as full year when fiscal (FY twenty twenty-six)
numbers.large_counts: natural grouping; prefer clarity over speed

quotations.rule: Slight voice color only; never mimic a character accent

tables_charts_bound_figures.rule: Do not read raw tables. If a figure is essential to the spoken argument, one short spoken paraphrase is allowed; otherwise skip — listener has the page.

arkansas_house_style.note: Never say 'Arkansas-es'. Spoken possessive collapses to the state name with slight hold.

recurring_guides.Rivers household: warm but analytical — illustration, not melodrama

signature_passage_criteria: Major turn or refusal (e.g. refuse fake totals)
Rivers / Phillips contrast that carries moral weight

models.rule: Cheap models for proof; v3 (and Actor Mode later) only where performance changes meaning

regeneration_rule: If paragraph N is wrong, regenerate paragraph N only — never the whole chapter.
